title: WINDSHIELD CORNERS-UPPER & LOWER
summary: Steel windshield frame corners in the body: upper corner reinforcements [1] and [2] at the top of the windshield (A-) pillar, and lower corner frames [3] (outer) and [4] (inner, LH/RH) at the cowl end of the hinge pillar, all spot-welded to each other and to the hinge pillar, with sealer-adhesive 86a and plastisol sealer 122b/d/e in the flanges. A stop [5] is riveted to the lower corner with its sloped face down, and a plug [7] is cemented (50g) into a hole in the hinge pillar.
